_note: Spec 32 FR-32-20. Input CSS -> scoped output for Custom_Css_Scoper::scope (PHP) and scopeCustomCss (JS). Both test suites read this file; scope is the instance selector passed to both.

cases.name: &selector becomes the doubled scope
a selector without &selector is scoped as a descendant, never page-wide
page roots are confined too
&selector with a descendant and a state
CSS-nesting & is the block
declarations outside a rule apply to the block
a rule inside @media lands on the instance only
an unscoped rule inside @media is scoped
@supports nested in @media
@container is walked
comments are removed
commas and braces inside strings and brackets do not split
& inside a string is not the scope
@import is refused, the rest kept
@font-face is refused, @keyframes is kept and renamed
cases.css: @font-face { font-family: x } @keyframes k { from { opacity: 0 } } &selector { color: red }

cases.name: @keyframes: the sparkle loop, guarded by a no-preference query and referenced before it is defined
cases.css: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { &selector { animation: sparkle 2.4s ease-in-out infinite } } @keyframes sparkle { 0% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0) } 50% { transform: scale(1.35) rotate(90deg) } 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(180deg) } }
cases.out: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){.s.s{animation: sparkle-s 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}}@keyframes sparkle-s{0%{transform: scale(1) rotate(0)}50%{transform: scale(1.35) rotate(90deg)}100%{transform: scale(1) rotate(180deg)}}

cases.name: @keyframes: two definitions, a comma list in animation and animation-name
cases.css: @keyframes fade { from { opacity: 0 } to { opacity: 1 } } @keyframes rise { 0%, 40% { translate: 0 8px } 100% { translate: 0 } } &selector { animation: fade 1s, rise 1s ease-out; } .x { animation-name: rise, fade; animation-duration: 2s }
cases.out: @keyframes fade-s{from{opacity: 0}to{opacity: 1}}@keyframes rise-s{0%,40%{translate: 0 8px}100%{translate: 0}}.s.s{animation: fade-s 1s, rise-s 1s ease-out}.s.s .x{animation-name: rise-s, fade-s; animation-duration: 2s}

cases.name: @keyframes: a name not defined in the input, and a longer name sharing a prefix, are left alone
cases.css: @keyframes pulse { to { opacity: .5 } } &selector { animation: spin 1s linear infinite } .y { animation: pulse-slow 1s, pulse 2s; transition-property: pulse }
cases.out: @keyframes pulse-s{to{opacity: .5}}.s.s{animation: spin 1s linear infinite}.s.s .y{animation: pulse-slow 1s, pulse-s 2s; transition-property: pulse}

cases.name: @keyframes: a bare declaration on the block is renamed too
@keyframes inside @media is kept and renamed
@keyframes with a non-percentage keyframe selector is refused whole; its name is then not renamed
cases.css: @keyframes k { from { opacity: 0 } .x { opacity: 1 } } &selector { animation: k 1s }

cases.name: @keyframes with a script-capable value is refused whole
cases.css: @keyframes k { to { background: url(javascript:alert(1)) } } &selector { color: red }

cases.name: @keyframes with a rule nested in a keyframe is refused whole
@keyframes with a declaration outside a keyframe is refused whole
cases.css: @keyframes k { opacity: 0; from { opacity: 1 } } &selector { color: red }

cases.name: @keyframes with a quoted or reserved name is refused
cases.css: @keyframes "k" { from { opacity: 0 } } @keyframes none { from { opacity: 0 } } &selector { color: red }

cases.name: @-webkit-keyframes is refused
a nested rule body is refused
a script-capable value is refused
markup refuses everything (no </style> breakout)
an extra closing brace refuses everything
refused: syntax: unbalanced braces or an unterminated string

cases.name: a missing closing brace refuses everything
refused: syntax: unbalanced braces or an unterminated string

cases.name: an unterminated comment refuses everything
an unterminated string refuses everything
refused: syntax: unbalanced braces or an unterminated string

cases.name: empty input
an empty rule emits nothing
